_comment: Source groups. Google News RSS is the backbone (incl. site: queries covering gov domains). gov_pages are best-effort direct scrapes - edit URLs here if a site changes layout. trusted_sources is the ANTI-FAKE-NEWS whitelist: Google News items whose publisher is NOT on the list are dropped.

trusted_sources._comment: Anti-fake-news whitelist. gov_pages + direct rss_feeds are trusted by origin. Google News items are KEPT ONLY IF their publisher matches a publisher_alias below. Matching is case-insensitive substring on the publisher name Google attaches to each item.
